minutes.headline: Planning Board denied the Northfield Road solar special permit and site plan; Summer Street fence applicant withdrew
minutes.summary: The board deliberated and denied the 994 Northfield Road large-scale solar special permit and site plan. It then heard a long dispute over a fence, a gas easement and property-line placement at 234 Summer Street, which ended with a withdrawal being accepted after the neighbors reached a side agreement. It also reviewed the Electric Ave restaurant parking lot, a Goodrich Street shared driveway, stormwater bylaw warrant articles and committee reports.

public_comment.topic: Applicant at 234 Summer Street said he would put the fence on the 10-foot mark, on the property line, and objected to the cost and delay.
Applicant read a National Grid letter saying the fence cannot go on the nine-foot gas easement, and said the fence must go on the property line.
Attorney for the abutter argued the fence was a zoning board condition and urged denial of the modification.
A board member presented proposed marijuana (RMD) bylaw changes and a student civics initiative, and sought permission to proceed.

votes.motion: Deny the special permit for 994 Northfield Road.
Deny site plan approval for 994 Northfield Road.
Continue the 234 Summer Street hearing to a date certain (later withdrawn).
Close the public hearing on the Electric Ave restaurant parking lot.
Accept withdrawal of the 234 Summer Street modification without prejudice.
Draft a letter saying the board lacks jurisdiction to approve a common driveway over 12 percent grade at Goodrich Street.
Close the public hearing on the stormwater warrant articles, then endorse the change.
Approve previous minutes, with Marjorie's name on all documents.
Move the definitions and use table to next week.

budget_items.what_was_said: Applicant said an 8-foot fence costs about double a lower one.
A member cited the PILOT for the town and donated conservation land as benefits.

decisions.decision: Town counsel to draft the written decisions on Northfield Road for board review.
Neighbors at 234 Summer Street agreed to fence terms: fence on the westerly property line, pins visible, short section then an 8-foot section.
Goodrich Street driveway to be revisited with the building commissioner; a letter to be drafted.
Board allowed a member to pursue the student civics initiative without representing the board.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to deny the special permit and site plan for the large-scale solar project at 994 Northfield Road; town counsel will draft the written decisions.
The board voted to deny site plan approval for 994 Northfield Road, following the denial of the special permit.
At 234 Summer Street, the board accepted withdrawal of the fence modification without prejudice after the neighbors agreed to fence terms on the westerly property line.
The board closed the public hearing on the Electric Ave restaurant parking lot site plan.
The board voted to close the stormwater bylaw hearing and endorse the change, and to draft a letter saying it lacks jurisdiction over the Goodrich Street common driveway grade.

why_it_matters: The Northfield Road denials mean the solar project, and the payment in lieu of taxes and conservation land a member cited as benefits, do not go forward on this permit unless the applicant seeks another approval.
The stormwater bylaw change that the board endorsed is a warrant article, so residents may be asked to vote on it at Town Meeting.
watch_next: Written decisions on 994 Northfield Road, to be drafted by town counsel for board review.
Next week's meeting, where the definitions and use table were moved.
